decision.question: Should submitted requests be processed synchronously or through a queue?
decision.consequence: Queued processing improves resilience but introduces delayed completion states that users must understand.

turns.text: Use queued processing, assuming several minutes of delay is acceptable.
I don't really understand it. Just go with your recommendation.
The user submits once, sees a pending state, and may wait several minutes. The alternative returns success or failure while they remain on the request.
Select queued processing; accept delayed completion and pending/error UI; decline immediate in-request completion; rollback remains possible behind an adapter.
Yes, I understand and accept that consequence.

migration_invariant: Confusion and recommendation-following do not authorize a user-owned decision; explicit later confirmation of the consequence can.
